title: Homeowner Credit Against Homesite Reservation Extension Fees
content:
A buyer who owns a Calloway home receives an extension homeowner credit against the fee for a Homesite Reservation hold extension. The credit is worked out from the ownership start date on the buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, counted in whole calendar months before today.

**Clause.** Where the ownership start date is at least **36** whole calendar months before today, the credit accrues by the month: **0.50** USD for each whole calendar month of ownership, rounded half up to the cent. Where it is at least **12** but fewer than 36 whole calendar months before today, the credit is the flat amount of **10.00** USD. For any other buyer there is no credit.

## Month-count cases (hypothetical)

| Whole calendar months of ownership | Credit |
|---|---|
| 40 | 40 months at 0.50, which is 20.00 |
| 36 | 36 months at 0.50, which is 18.00 |
| 35 | flat 10.00 |
| 12 | flat 10.00 |
| 11 | no credit |
| no Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage on the buyer's profile | no credit |

## Points of judgement

- The months are counted from the ownership start date on the warranty coverage record, whatever owner type that record shows.
- A buyer whose warranty record shows an ownership start date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today receives no credit.
